newsitem.title: UK: Lavendon Group to float at 140 pence per share.
newsitem.headline: Lavendon Group to float at 140 pence per share.

text.p: Lavendon Group Plc, the power access equipment fleet operator, on Wednesday announced its flotation details, saying shares are being placed at 140 pence per share to raise a net 11.33 million stg.
The market capitalisation at the issue price is 29.83 million stg.
Lavendon, which last month said it hoped to raise between eight and 12 million stg, is issuing 12.1 million shares, of which 8.6 million are new shares.
Dealing in the shares is expected to start on October 10.
The shares are being placed at a forecast price/earnings multiple of 13.26 with Lavendon expecting earnings per share for this calendar year to be 10.56 pence per share.
Pre-tax year profit is forecast to rise 41.7 percent to 2.55 million stg.

"We believe we are now well positioned in a market with impressive growth prospects and we look forward to the opportunities and advantages provied by the successful flotation of the group," said Lavendon's chairman, David Price, in a statement.
